architecture.dependency_direction: cli.py → arguments.py + overrides.py; train_ppo.py → lifecycle.py + overrides.py + resolved_config.py; orchestrator.py → all sub-modules; sub-modules NEVER import from cli.py or train_ppo.py
lazy_imports: arguments.py::build_train_parser() lazily imports DEFAULT_CLI_TRAINING_PRESET from rl.train_ppo
train_ppo.py::train_ppo() lazily imports orchestrate_training_run from orchestrator.py
lifecycle.py uses TYPE_CHECKING guard for PPOConfig to avoid torch at import time
train_ppo.py diagnostic functions (run_verify_4v4, run_test_vec_schema) lazily import numpy

modules.errors.py: Typed training error hierarchy: TrainingConfigError(ValueError), EvaluationOnlyPresetError, PresetsConflictError, CheckpointNotFoundError(FileNotFoundError), TrainingAbortedError(RuntimeError)
modules.run_context.py: Mutable RunContext dataclass: run_lock (acquired lock handle), rc_path (sidecar JSON path) — holds per-run acquired state
modules.resolved_config.py: Frozen ResolvedTrainingConfig dataclass + resolve_training_config(cfg) — computes max_agents, team_size, curriculum, initial_phase/opponent, effective lr/ent_coef/clip/n_epochs/batch_size, rollout_size. Also owns _resolve_initial_opponent_and_phase.
modules.lifecycle.py: Pure lifecycle operations: set_global_seed, _resolve_metrics_csv_paths, _rotate_fresh_run_telemetry, _clamp_runtime_config_for_team_size, _ensure_cuda_or_fallback, teardown_training. Uses TYPE_CHECKING to avoid torch at module import.
modules.factories.py: Re-exports build_training_env from env_factory.py; provides make_trainer_hyperparams(resolved) -> dict
modules.initialization.py: build_trainer(env, cfg, resolved), maybe_load_checkpoint(cfg, trainer), maybe_extend_total_timesteps(cfg, trainer)
modules.arguments.py: Full argparse builder extracted from cli.py::parse_train_args. build_train_parser() lazily imports DEFAULT_CLI_TRAINING_PRESET. Zero module-level torch dependency.
modules.orchestrator.py: _validate_config_gates(cfg) + orchestrate_training_run(cfg) — canonical full training sequence extracted from old train_ppo() body

pre_existing_failures.cause: tests do `from rl.train_ppo import PPOConfig` which triggers gpu_env -> torch; pre-existing before Phase 8
